draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.88, the 206th-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 21st of 26 at LB. He went 134th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (206th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 23 tackles in 2024, 24th of 25 LBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 2 pro, currently with the Denver Broncos. 6 career games and 0 starts over 1 completed season, plus 4 so far in 2026. Still developing: 1 AV in 2025. Weak spots: approximate value 1 (14th percentile). Played 6 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-1 edge rusher who played: 0.5 sacks against a median of 1.0, below the norm.
